Head of Product — Trading & Wallet, Remote.

ChainVault is a crypto-native exchange and on-chain wallet provider. We're hiring a Head of Product to own our token-incentive programme end to end: staking rewards, liquidity-mining campaigns, and on-chain governance voting for our native token. You'll lead a team of four PMs covering the trading engine, the self-custody wallet, and the DeFi integrations layer, reporting directly to the co-founder/CEO. Deep familiarity with on-chain mechanics — smart contracts, gas optimisation, wallet key management — is essential; you'll be in daily conversations with our protocol engineers about tokenomics design. Fully remote, work from anywhere. We raised a large round from crypto-focused funds last year and are scaling the token ecosystem aggressively.
